In recent years, user-contributed investment services such as SeekingAlpha and StockTwits have grown to millions of users.

arxiv-1803-06890.creator: E. Brunsden, K. R. Pollard, D. J. Wright, P. De Cat, P. L. Cottrell
arxiv-1803-06890.description: Abstract The prototype star for the γ \gamma Doradus class of pulsating variables was studied employing photometric and spectroscopic observations to determine the frequencies and modes of pulsation. The four frequencies found are self-consistent between the observation types and almost identical to those found in previous studies ( 1.3641 1.3641 d -1 , 1.8783 1.8783 d -1 , 1.4742 1.

arxiv-2008-10774.title: Image Colorization: A Survey and Dataset
arxiv-2008-10774.creator: Saeed Anwar, Muhammad Tahir, Chongyi Li, Ajmal Mian, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Abdul Wahab Muzaffar
arxiv-2008-10774.description: Abstract Image colorization estimates RGB colors for grayscale images or video frames to improve their aesthetic and perceptual quality. Over the last decade, deep learning techniques for image colorization have significantly progressed, necessitating a systematic survey and benchmarking of these techniques.

arxiv-2105-13322.title: Characterizing finite nilpotent groups associated with a graph theoretic equality
arxiv-2105-13322.creator: Ramesh Prasad Panda, Kamal Lochan Patra, Binod Kumar Sahoo
arxiv-2105-13322.description: Abstract The power graph of a group is the simple graph whose vertices are the group elements and two vertices are adjacent whenever one of them is a positive power of the other. We characterize the finite nilpotent groups whose power graphs have equal vertex connectivity and minimum degree. Key words.

arxiv-2310-04362.title: Einsteinian gravitational concepts throughout secondary school
arxiv-2310-04362.creator: Corey McInerney, Phil Sutton
arxiv-2310-04362.description: Abstract Einstein’s theory of relativity is largely thought of as one of the most important discoveries of the 20 th century and continues to pass observational tests over 100 years later. Yet, it is Newtonian gravity, a 350 year old formalism proven to be less accurate than relativity, which is taught in schools.

arxiv-2405-17613.title: Jointly Modeling Inter- & Intra-Modality Dependencies for Multi-modal Learning
arxiv-2405-17613.creator: Divyam MadaanTaro Makino, Sumit Chopra, Kyunghyun Cho
arxiv-2405-17613.description: Abstract Supervised multi-modal learning involves mapping multiple modalities to a target label. Previous studies in this field have concentrated on capturing in isolation either the inter-modality dependencies (the relationships between different modalities and the label) or the intra-modality dependencies (the relationships within a single modality and the label).

arxiv-2406-18130.title: Designing Unit Ising Models for Logic Gate Simulation through Integer Linear Programming
arxiv-2406-18130.creator: Shunsuke Tsukiyama, Koji Nakano, Xiaotian Li, Yasuaki Ito, Takumi Kato, Yuya Kawamata
arxiv-2406-18130.description: Abstract An Ising model is defined by a quadratic objective function known as the Hamiltonian, composed of spin variables that can take values of either − 1 -1 or + 1 +1 . The goal is to assign spin values to these variables in a way that minimizes the value of the Hamiltonian.

arxiv-2409-01126.title: Analytic results in aligned axion inflation
arxiv-2409-01126.creator: Federico Greco, Marco Peloso
arxiv-2409-01126.description: Abstract The original model of axion natural inflation produces a tensor-to-scalar ratio above the experimental limit. Aligned axion inflation admits inflationary trajectories that originate near a saddle point of the two-field potential, and terminate due to the instability of the orthogonal direction.

arxiv-2410-08178.title: The mystery of water in the atmosphere of τ \tau Boötis b continues: insights from revisiting archival CRIRES observations
arxiv-2410-08178.creator: Vatsal Panwar, Matteo Brogi, Siddharth Gandhi Heather Cegla Marina Lafarga
arxiv-2410-08178.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Vatsal Panwar, Matteo Brogi, Siddharth Gandhi Heather Cegla Marina Lafarga. The chemical abundances of gas-giant exoplanet atmospheres hold clues to the formation and evolution pathways that sculpt the exoplanet population. Recent ground-based high-resolution spectroscopic observations of the non-transiting hot Jupiter τ \tau Boötis b from different instruments have resulted in a tension on the presence of water vapour in the planet’s atmosphere, which impact the planet’s inferred C/O and metallicity.

arxiv-2506-15925.title: Reranking-based Generation for Unbiased Perspective Summarization
arxiv-2506-15925.creator: Narutatsu Ri, Nicholas Deas, Kathleen McKeown
arxiv-2506-15925.description: Abstract Generating unbiased summaries in real-world settings such as political perspective summarization remains a crucial application of Large Language Models (LLMs). Yet, existing evaluation frameworks rely on traditional metrics for measuring key attributes such as coverage and faithfulness without verifying their applicability, and efforts to develop improved summarizers are still nascent.

arxiv-2512-01123.title: A Hybrid Architecture for Options Wheel Strategy Decisions: LLM-Generated Bayesian Networks for Transparent Trading
arxiv-2512-01123.creator: Xiaoting Kuang xiaotingkuangcu@gmail.com Boken Lin boken.lin@utoronto.ca
arxiv-2512-01123.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at understanding context and qualitative nuances but struggle with the rigorous and transparent reasoning required in high-stakes quantitative domains such as financial trading. We propose a model-first hybrid architecture for the options ”wheel” strategy that combines the strengths of LLMs with the robustness of a Bayesian Network.

europmc-pmc6682904.creator: Hills RD, Pontefract BA, Mishcon HR, Black CA, Sutton SC, Theberge CR.
europmc-pmc6682904.description: The gut microbiome plays an important role in human health and influences the development of chronic diseases ranging from metabolic disease to gastrointestinal disorders and colorectal cancer. Of increasing prevalence in Western societies, these conditions carry a high burden...

pmc-10626719.title: Atypical presentations of primary acquired hypothyroidism – a case series
pmc-10626719.creator: R R Pravin, Sheau Yun Kan, Ser Yee Soh, Daniel Chan, Rashida Farhad Vasanwala
pmc-10626719.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Primary acquired hypothyroidism in children manifests with a myriad of clinical presentations. Clinical features can be insidious in nature, often under the guise of non-specific presentations to other subspecialties prior to referral to the endocrinologist. Growth failure is a hallmark feature in these children alongside their presenting clinical symptomology which needs to be identified through detailed history, physical examination and analysis of the growth charts.

pmc-11419589.title: Normocytic Anemia as a Side Effect of Clozapine: A Case Report
pmc-11419589.creator: Tambi I Isaac
pmc-11419589.description: This brief case report aims to shed light on an uncommon blood-related side effect potentially associated with clozapine use, an atypical antipsychotic primarily prescribed for treatment-resistant schizophrenia.A 70-year-old white male with a significant past medical history of schizophrenia controlled with clozapine was evaluated over approximately two months.

pmc-11508221.title: Indirect-Oscillation Sign Suggesting Infective Endocarditis on the Routine Chest CT
pmc-11508221.creator: Min Ji Son, Seung Min Yoo, Hwa Yeon Lee, Charles S White, Jörg Männer
pmc-11508221.description: Routine chest CT is not essential for the diagnostic workup for infective endocarditis (IE), but this type of study may be the initial imaging modality in the evaluation of patients ultimately proven to have IE who present to the emergency department with nonspecific clinical symptoms.

pmc-11731007.title: Periductal Mastitis Occurring Among Hubble-Bubble Smokers: A Report of Two Cases and Literature Review
pmc-11731007.creator: Rami Yaghan, Nehad M Ayoub, Lamees R Yaghan, Abdulla I Mohamed
pmc-11731007.description: Periductal mastitis (PM) is a form of nonlactational mastitis. The clinical picture varies from mild periareolar inflammation to frank retroareolar abscess formation. A huge amount of literature is incriminating cigarette smoking as a major contributing factor to the etiology of PM, and cessation of smoking is essential for a successful treatment.

pmc-12802348.title: Sustained circulation of Aedes albopictus-derived novel almendraviruses in the urban parks
pmc-12802348.creator: Xi Zhang, Chengyu Liu, Yang Han, Junying She, Wanqi Wu, Lili Wang, Jingdong Song, George F Gao, Ziqian Xu, Hao Liang, Jun Liu
pmc-12802348.description: Highlights•Scientific question: Aedes albopictus (Ae. albopictus) serves as a significant viral vector, and characterizing the diversity of viruses is essential for deciphering vector-viral community composition and refining viral surveillance strategies.•Evidence before this study: Almendraviruses (family Rhabdoviridae) have been exclusively isolated from mosquitoes or detected in dipteran insect pools.

pmc-12815797.title: Integrative multi-omics stratification and translational evaluation of Treg-targeted combination immunotherapy in breast cancer
pmc-12815797.creator: Nari Kim, Seongwon Na, Hyo Jin Lee, Woojin Yi, Ga Won Son, Jin Park, Jisung Jang, Mihyun Kim, Seong-Yun Jeong, Kyung Won Kim
pmc-12815797.description: BackgroundImmunosuppressive breast cancer subtypes driven by regulatory T cells (Tregs) remain under-characterized, limiting precise identification of patients who may benefit from immunomodulatory therapies. Tregs are key mediators of immunosuppression within the tumor microenvironment (TME) and are closely associated with resistance to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs).

pmc-13068381.title: Salivary Testosterone Concentration and Cognitive Impairment among Japanese Older Adults in the Toon Health Study
pmc-13068381.creator: Juna Kamijima, Ai Ikeda, Hadrien Charvat, Koutatsu Maruyama, Kiyohide Tomooka, Ryoichi Kawamura, Yasunori Takata, Haruhiko Osawa, Madoka Tatsukawa, Miyuki Yoshida, Akiko Kooka, Tamami Shiba, Tomoko Nishiyama, Kazumi Fujimura, Keiko Suyama, Isao Saito, Takeshi Tanigawa
pmc-13068381.description: IntroductionAs the number of people with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) increases, modifiable risk factors, such as stress and an unhealthy lifestyle, and preventative measures are gaining interest. However, evidence for an association between potential biomarkers of such risk factors and MCI is limited.

pmc-13202758.title: E2F1-mediated 53BP2 lactylation stabilizes p53 to induce cochlear hair cell apoptosis in mouse age-related hearing loss
pmc-13202758.creator: Xiaoqin Luo, Jun Liu, Chanyuan Zhang, Wei Yuan, Gang Qin
pmc-13202758.description: Age-related hearing loss (ARHL) is a prevalent sensory deficit characterized by cochlear hair cell apoptosis, yet the underlying epigenetic mechanisms remain unclear. This study investigated the role of E2F1-mediated 53BP2 lactylation in ARHL pathogenesis using naturally aging C57BL/6J mice and HEI-OC1 cochlear hair cell-like cells.

pmc-13230953.title: Semantic relatedness and the efficacy of retrieval practice
pmc-13230953.creator: Mohan W Gupta, Steven C Pan, Timothy C Rickard
pmc-13230953.description: Retrieval practice (i.e., practice testing) enhances recall relative to other study methods, but it is still unclear when it helps most. Here, we ask if testing is more beneficial for weakly or strongly related word pairs. Participants studied word pairs with either low or high semantic relatedness, then practiced them using either test-with-feedback or restudy.
